zh-CN.title: 小程序新功能视觉对齐
items: 空间成员目录现已对齐网页端的搜索、在线状态与快捷操作
欢迎消息编辑器会沿用当前聊天背景和气泡，并提供一致的输入与媒体面板
邮箱认证提示与广场置顶发言完成视觉统一

en.title: New mini program features visually aligned
items: The space member directory now matches the web experience for search, presence, and quick actions
The welcome-message editor now uses your active chat background and bubbles with a consistent composer and media panel
Email verification guidance and pinned Square posts now share the same visual treatment
